$comment: Composition contract for the Home screen at desktop, measured from the concept spec in source pixels. Regions become percent rects (rect / sourceSize) consumed by BOTH the CSS grid that lays the screen out and e2e/tests/arcade-regions.spec.ts, which asserts each [data-region] element's bounding box matches within tolerance. Fictional concept panels are re-purposed for real content but keep the concept's geometry.
